_help: creators = campaigns Rohit has joined. permission=true means he joined the campaign (permission_proof says which). platforms: where clips may be posted (campaign rules). voice: AI commentary voice allowed. caption_suffix: required caption text/tags. credit_line: credit text in the post (no URLs where the campaign forbids links). overlay: required image on the whole video. end_text: on-screen call to action at the end. hold: true = do not post yet (rules or assets missing).
